headline: Key exceptions for FastAPI error handling
why: The HTTPException and WebSocketException classes are critical for error handling in FastAPI. Changes to these classes can affect how errors are communicated to clients across multiple dependent modules.
checklist: Review modifications to HTTPException and WebSocketException constructors.
Ensure that any changes maintain compatibility with existing error handling patterns.
Check for updates in the documentation links provided in the class docstrings.
Verify that the examples remain accurate and functional after changes.
